name: augment flow along residual paths
mechanism: while a path from source to sink exists with spare capacity on every edge (counting reverse edges as undo capacity), push the bottleneck amount along it; the sum of pushes is a maximum flow

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Ford–Fulkerson algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Network theory: computes the maximum flow in a graph
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Edmonds–Karp algorithm': implementation of Ford–Fulkerson
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Dinic's algorithm': is a strongly polynomial algorithm for computing the maximum flow in a flow network.

requires: a rule for which path (shortest by edges gives the polynomial bound; level graphs with blocking flows give better)
fails_when: arbitrary path choice may not terminate on irrational capacities
